اقترحتن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَحْتُنَّ (iqtaraḥtunna) /iq.ta.raħ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# اُقْتُرِحْتُنَّ (uqturiḥtunna) /uq.tu.riħ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
